name: Blood Moon Sound
description: Plays your own sound clips: blood moon horde (and/or a warning earlier that day), when you enter the world, and morning and night bells at this world's dawn and dusk. Drop bloodmoon / spawn / morning / night as .ogg, .wav, or .mp3 into this folder (several of a kind play at random). Players: the server does not need it. Server (optional): posts blood moon updates, a horde recap and server events to Discord and game chat; players do not need it for that.
